scenes.name: Quick notes
scenes.about: Capture NUTs and materials, then group related ideas.
scenes.rules: Keep the original materials and their sources. Create a separate deliverable based on the current goal and submit it for review.

tasks.name: Organize into a note
tasks.goal: Write a note that states the topic, main points, and open questions.

scenes.name: Content creation
scenes.about: Go from source material and candidate topics to an outline or first draft.
scenes.rules: Cite sources for verifiable claims. Ask the author to confirm personal experiences and opinions. Review the outline before writing a long draft, and submit the draft for approval before saving it as a result.

tasks.name: Assess a topic
tasks.goal: Write one page on the intended reader, a promising angle, available material, and points to verify.

tasks.name: Make an outline
tasks.goal: Propose an angle, section structure, and material for each section. Submit it for review.

tasks.name: Write a first draft
tasks.goal: Submit an outline for approval, then write a sourced first draft.

scenes.name: Research
scenes.about: Screen sources, compare evidence, and prepare a research brief.
scenes.rules: Keep source citations and original materials. Distinguish evidence, inference, and hypotheses. State the limitations of the evidence and any open questions.

tasks.name: Screen sources
tasks.goal: Screen sources for relevance and evidence quality. Explain what you included or excluded.

tasks.name: Compare evidence
tasks.goal: Compare research design, findings, and limitations across sources in a table.

tasks.name: Write a research brief
tasks.goal: Cover the research question, evidence, limitations, and next steps.

scenes.name: Product and projects
scenes.about: Group feedback and screenshots into problems, then compare possible solutions.
scenes.rules: Separate raw feedback from analysis. State the scope, tradeoffs, and acceptance criteria. Ask the user to decide open questions.

tasks.name: Summarize feedback
tasks.goal: Group feedback by problem and identify the available evidence and impact.

tasks.name: Compare options
tasks.goal: Create a table of candidate options, tradeoffs, and assumptions to test.

tasks.name: Draft an implementation plan
tasks.goal: State the goal, scope, acceptance criteria, and decisions the user needs to make.

ruleTemplates.name: General organization
steps: Read the issue materials and list what is known and what needs confirmation.
Propose an approach and prepare a draft for the current goal.
Submit the draft for user review.

ruleTemplates.name: Article writing
steps: Organize sources and flag claims to verify.
Propose an angle and outline. Wait for approval before drafting.
Distinguish direct quotations, inferences, and experiences the author needs to supply.

ruleTemplates.name: Product and projects
steps: Summarize raw feedback and separate observations from analysis.
Explain scope, tradeoffs, and acceptance criteria.
Ask the user to resolve open decisions.

ruleTemplates.name: Research
steps: Define the research question and scope.
Summarize evidence, sources, and limitations. Record hypotheses to test.
Submit a research brief and follow-up questions for review.
